question: Are rulings kept as signed csoai.ruling/0.1 records, with an advisory reviewer panel and the owner binding until measured panel independence reaches n_eff 2?

rule_applied.ref: Proposal section 4 (A to E) of the council-mechanism note
rule_applied.text: Fixed rules alone set measured states. Ruling-class questions become signed records. The panel is advisory until its measured n_eff is at least 2.

evidence.of: the committed proposal section that defines csoai.ruling/0.1
the committed byte-exact excerpt of the owner-rulings log this record quotes

effect.note: Adopts the record format. Sets no state; the records it creates set none either.

attestation.content_id_rule: sha256(RFC 8785 JCS of the record without its 'signature' key)

signature.note: Detached Ed25519 over signature.attestation (RFC 8785 JCS; identical to the board signer's sorted-key form for this ASCII object), issued through POST /api/board-sign on the pod caller token. The attestation commits to this record by content_id. The design note proposed a separate ruling key; none is minted, so this names the board key it was signed under.
